title: Exponents & Scientific Notation
preview: Properties of exponents, negative and zero exponents, and scientific notation for very large and very small numbers.
description: Students extend integer exponent rules, then use scientific notation to compare quantities across many orders of magnitude — from atoms to astronomical scales.

sections.label: 1-1 Properties of Exponents
sections.description: Product, quotient, and power-of-a-power rules with whole-number exponents.

sections.label: 1-2 Zero & Negative Exponents
sections.description: Extend exponent rules to zero and negative integers.

sections.label: 1-3 Scientific Notation
sections.description: Write and compare numbers in scientific notation across many orders of magnitude.

sections.label: 1-4 Operations with Scientific Notation
sections.description: Multiply, divide, and compare numbers written in scientific notation.

sections.label: 1-5 Exponential Growth in Context
sections.description: Apply exponents to real growth contexts (doubling, compounding).

source.name: Plug N Play
